description: Elections Commission - R. J. Jayasinghe of the Maharagama Urban Council has vacated his office of the member of United National Party - D. B. Weerasinghe of the Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that two local government members have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and office vacancies.
